title: Spend the remaining day on what lasts
summary: Day and night are reducing the account. Spend the remaining hours on the profit of Naam instead of another postponement.
takeaway: Let the diminishing day purchase the profit of Naam.
lifeApplication: Give one remaining hour to what can go with you: remembrance, reconciliation, seva, or truthful prayer.

source.shortMeaning: Life diminishes day and night, so the mind is urged to meet the Guru and set its affairs right.
source.lifeApplication: When time slips, turn one remaining hour toward the profit of Naam.

evidence.coreClaim: Life diminishes day and night, so the mind is urged to meet the Guru and set its affairs right.
evidence.turn: The shabad turns a vanishing day into a market of holy urgency — buy what will still remain.
evidence.practicalImplication: Give one remaining hour to what can go with you: remembrance, reconciliation, seva, or truthful prayer.
